jobs_results.title: Senior DevOps Engineering - Santander Digital Services
jobs_results.description:
Senior DevOps Engineering - Santander Digital Services

Country: Spain

SANTANDER DIGITAL SERVICES is looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer based in one of our Hubs in Boadilla del Monte ,Cantabria and Málaga.

WHY YOU SHOULD CONSIDER THIS OPPORTUNITY

At Santander (www.santander.com) we are key players in the transformation of the financial sector. Do you want to join us?

Santander Digital Services (SDS) is the team of technology and operations at Santander. We are convinced of the importance of technology that is aligned with the requirements of the business and that out work not only brings value to users, people and communities but also fosters individual creativity. Our team of over 7,000 people in 8 countries (Spain, Portugal, Poland, UK, USA, Mexico, Chile and Brazil) develops and/or implements financial solutions across a broad spectrum of technologies (including Blockchain, Big Data and Angular among others) on all kinds of on-premises and cloud-based platforms.

UK Tower is... the Santander UK Nearshoring strategy vehicle in Santander Digital Services located in Spain, to provide technology workforce and services directly to Santander UK that will work together and for UK Technology teams.

Santander is proud of being an organization where there are equal opportunities regardless of gender identity, culture and disability. Our mission is to contribute to help more people and business prosper. We embrace a strong risk culture and all of our professionals at all levels are expected to take a proactive and responsible approach toward risk management.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you will have the opportunity to lead and coordinate software projects in a highly dynamic and inventive environment.

We value delivering high-quality products that meet the needs of our customers. To this end, we are seeking candidates who will oversee the entire software development lifecycle, from planning to deployment and beyond.

We need someone like you to help us in different fronts:
• Identifying, planning, and implementing solutions to improve the reliability, resilience and efficiency of the public cloud environment by developing innovative and automated processes.
• Providing high level advice on technical solutions and priorities for the infrastructure function.
• Focusing on day-to-day operations, delivery of new services and solutions and capacity planning to ensure IT infrastructure meets the current and future requirements of the organization.
• Ensuring the provision of full-service delivery, undertaking, and supporting structure planning to ensure sufficient system capacity is made available.
• Resolving complex technical issues and providing senior technical solutions in response to queries from across the business as well as from within IT.
• Analyzing technical specifications of systems infrastructure and communication platforms, to meet the needs of San UK
• Train the development team on design patterns and performance tuning strategies. Be passionate about making nitty gritty, hands-on improvements.
• Lead and mentor a team of engineers to further their technical prowess. You succeed when your team does!

EXPERIENCE
• +5 years of related experience.

EDUCATION
• University degree in technology, preferably in computer science.

SKILLS & KNOWLEDGE
• Knowledge of DevOps tooling and methodologies including code repositories, bug tracking tools, Confluence, JIRA etc.
• Knowledge of IT incident management: ability to investigate, troubleshoot, recover and prevent the recurrence of incidents that interfere with the normal delivery of IT services.
• Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)
• Skills and experience in Change Control/Incident management of leading the recovery of infrastructure outages.
• A strong understanding of API orchestration, combined with languages such as Python to implement automated solutions and interactions between core management services such as Dynatrace, AWS, ServiceNow etc.
• Experience in software development and/or system administration, with a focus on reliability, availability, and scalability.
• Strong focus on design and delivery, taking complex problems and delivering well documented and tested solutions to those problems.

OTHER INFORMATION
• English at least C1
• Availability to travel if needed.

If you want to know more about us, visit our website https://www.betechwithsantander.com/en/home

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
We are seeking an experienced Dev Ops Engineer to start immediately. This would be a full-time on-site position at our office in Barcelona. The same position in Madrid office is also available.

The job requires the following responsabilities:
• Leading test and integration efforts with regards to deploying mission critical software.
• Developing new ways of automation and continuous delivery.
• Taking ownership of technical issues, and working with our Development group to resolve more advanced issues when necessary.
• Resolving escalated customer complaints.
• Documenting troubleshooting and problem resolution steps.

Qualifications
• Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Science / Engineering or related field.
• Have exceptional troubleshooting and customer-handling skills.
• Show excellent communication in English (both verbal and written).
• Proven experience working with distributed Linux operating systems (installation, configuration and troubleshooting).
• Understanding of... Linux core fundamentals, command-line operations, scripting and service monitoring.
• Solid understanding of IP networking and network devices.
• Experience with Kernel and network based tuning for performance and stability.
• Experience with automation and configuration management using provisioning tools like Ansible.
• Strong support and/or administration experience for enterprise software solutions.
• Good scripting skills (awk, sed, bash).
• Understanding of one or more programming languages such as Java, Python, or C++.
• Firm understanding of version control systems such as subversion.
• Solid understanding of agilie methodologies, working in small teams, Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery

Profesionales con experiencia como Arquitecto/a senior AWS que quieran formar parte de nuestra unidad de Cloud & Custom Applications, donde compartirás conocimientos con más de 1.700 personas que... te ayudaran a afrontar nuevos retos con las tecnologías más punteras del mercado. ¿Tienes curiosidad por conocer a algunos de nuestros mejores profesionales? ¿Deseas conocer a nuestros expertos H.K y R.P?

The state capital of Munich

The ITdepartment is responsible for and shapes the entire IT of the Cityof Munich. We ensure that IT provision meets the city's current andfuture needs.

We drive the digitalization of the city of Munich andplay a pioneering role. Our work and our services... make the city ofMunich a digital metropolis that sets standards that its employeesare proud of.

As part of the IT department, we ensure amodern IT and telecommunications infrastructure, implementprofessional IT solutions and secure the IT operations of the Cityof Munich with over 1,200 employees in our own company it@M.

What you can expect

Asa DevOps Engineer, you will find yourself in an exciting workenvironment that includes optimizing existing applications as wellas implementing and planning (new) IT solutions.

As part of DevOps,you will also be responsible for operating Linux servers, whichalso includes analyzing and eliminating faults (service requests,2nd / 3rd level support, etc.).

Your tasks will includethe operation and maintenance of IT systems for the specialistprocedures supported in the service area (including trade,restaurants, weapons, regulatory offenses, lost property managementand fire inspection).

This includes monitoring and troubleshooting,ensuring the required availability, carrying out operationalsecurity measures (e.

g. installing releases from internal andexternal process manufacturers, restarting applications) and systemoptimizations.

In all these activities, you will alwayswork together with your team colleagues and in close coordinationwith our customers in the district administration department andthe fire department, the external product manufacturers, theinternal and external partner procedures and our infrastructureteams.

Occasionally, the job requires you towork outside of core working hours. This can occasionally lead toweekend work or on-call duty.

• Independent, autonomousprocessing of your own area of responsibility
• a permanent position in EGr. 11 (depending on experiencelevel from € 4,032.38 to € 5,975.19 gross per month for full-timeemployment)
• Annual special payment as wellas an attractive company pension scheme, capital-forming benefits,a local and family allowance, coverage of the Deutschlandticket Jobor subsidy for the IsarCardJob (tax-free) and performance-relatedpay
• Possibility to rent a company apartmentfrom LHM
• A good work-life balance throughflexible working hours, forms of work (e.g. mobile working, homeoffice) and individually selectable working time models
• Reserved childcare places in municipal crèches,kindergartens and after-school care centers
• a wide range of training and development opportunities (individualdevelopment opportunities, excellent formats and modern forms oflearning)
• Internal development opportunities- a wide range of departments and specialist areas promise avariety of tasks
• Comprehensive companyhealth management

You have
• a successfully completeduniversity degree in the field of computer science, administrativeinformatics or business informatics or
• asuccessfully completed university degree or equivalent skills andexperience
• several years (at least two years) ofprofessional experience in the administration of IT solutions

In particular, you will have
• Specialist knowledge : Severalyears (at least two years) of experience in life cycle managementof specialist applications, knowledge of the typical technologystack on which modern IT solutions are based, such as theinteraction of databases (Oracle), application servers (JBOSS),middleware (Apache Tomcat, Openshift) and fat / web clients, Linuxservers and associated scripting languages (Bash)
• Result and goal orientation, especially technicalproblem-solving skills
• Ability to cooperateand deal with conflict

• Knowledgeof SQL and Java

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Who we are

Aizon is an AI software provider that transforms manufacturing operations using advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and other smart factory technologies. Our mission is to improve global health in order to change patients’ lives . We aim to do that by optimizing the way medicines are manufactured so that pharma and biotech companies can provide patients worldwide with the right medicine at the right time and at the right price. We are based in thriving San Francisco and sunny Barcelona, with customers and partners spanning the globe.

We are looking for new team members who share our values: trust, customer-centricity, innovation, integrity, collaboration, and passion.

We are embarking on an important journey, working to contribute to something impactful and new in the Life Sciences industry!

The Position

- Assuring that the platform is automatized, taken care of, and maintained efficiently

- Being responsible for Infrastructure Delivery Automation processes... in AWS

- Reporting to the Chief Platform Architect
Responsibilities
• Design, develop, and implement infrastructure on AWS using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles with Terraform, Terragrunt, and AWS CloudFormation.
• Automate infrastructure provisioning and management using IaC.
• Manage and optimize cloud resources for cost and performance.
• Implement continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines for infrastructure deployments and company code using tools like Jenkins, Github Actions, and Bitbucket Pipelines.
• Ensure configuration management processes and infrastructure comply with ISO 9001 and 27001 standards.
• Evaluate new technologies for potential platform improvements
• Automate infrastructure patching and vulnerability management.
• Monitor and respond to security incidents.
• Maintain Bash and Python scripts
Knowledge & Experience
• Must-have
• 3+ years of experience using AWS cloud technologies in a DevOps or similar role.
• Proficient in Infrastructure as Code (IaC), particularly with Terraform and Terragrunt.
• Strong understanding of AWS services for infrastructure provisioning, management, and security.
• Experience with CI/CD pipelines for automated deployments.
• Good scripting skills (Bash, Python, etc.)
• Experience in Windows and Linux OS
• Good problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
• Effective communication and collaboration skills.
• Experience with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, Github, Bitbucket CI/CD).
• Nice-have
• AWS Certifications or specialty
• Docker and AWS ECR demonstrated experience
• AWS Security tools experience (Security Hub, Config, System Manager, etc.)

jobs_results.title: Cloud DevOps Engineer - Santander Digital Services
jobs_results.description:
Cloud Devops Engineer - Santander Digital Services

Country: Spain
• *WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING**
• *Santander Digital Services está buscando un/a **Cloud Devops Engineer **para nuestras oficinas en ABELIAS (Madrid).**
• *POR QUÉ DEBERÍAS CONSIDERAR ESTA OPORTUNIDAD**

En Santander, la tecnología tiene un papel esencial. No solo nos estamos transformando nosotros, también estamos liderando la evolución de la banca como sector. Estamos determinados en convertirnos en la mejor plataforma de servicios financieros, y queremos que te unas a nuestro equipo, trabajando en un entorno abierto y colaborativo, desarrollando tus habilidades tecnológicas y aplicándolas a proyectos e iniciativas que ayudarán a mejorar la vida de muchas personas.
• *QUÉ HARÁS EN TU TRABAJO**

Como **Cloud Devops Engineer **, tu objetivo será Creación, validación y productivización de herramientas que faciliten el Continuous Delivery y el Continuous Deployment de las aplicaciones, en especial las orientadas a la Cloud... tanto privada como pública. El objetivo principal es mejorar el time to market de las aplicaciones de negocio mediante palancas como el despliegue automático y testing automatizado.

Necesitamos a alguien como tú para que nos ayude en distintos ámbitos:

- Análisis de impacto y requerimientos.
- Desarrollos y despliegues.
- Soporte a equipos de Desarrollo y devOps que consumen nuestras herramientas.
- Evangelización para el uso de las nuevas herramientas.
- Innovación y evoluciones en las actuales herramientas y en futuros posibles desarrollos.

EXPERIENCIA
- Experiência en desarrollo e implantación de plataformas de CI/CD sobre Jenkins, GitHub actions o similar.
- Conocimiento en plataformas/servicios cloud (Azure, Openshift, AWS, )
- Experiência de al menos 2 años desarrollando pipelines, microservicios, servicios cloud,
- Experiência trabajando en metodología agile (Scrum, Kanban) orientada a objetivos.
- Experiência en desarrollo de aplicaciones E2E (desde el análisis hasta la puesta en producción)
- Trabajo con equipos distribuidos.

EDUCACIÓN
- Preferible Titulación superior en Ingeniería o Informática.
- FPII/ Diploma Técnico Superior: Ingeniería Informática.

HABILIDADES & CONOCIMIENTOS
- Conocimiento de algunas de las siguientes plataformas:

- Azure
- Openshift
- Kubernetes
- Docker
- Helm
- Nexus
- Sonar
- Conocimiento de algunos de los siguientes lenguajes:

- Springboot
- Node
- Angular
- Python
- Groovy
- Ansible
- Inglés (no es imprescindible, pero si se valorará conocimientos en el idioma)
• *Idiomas**:

- Spanish

jobs_results.description:
Req ID: 303945
Red Bee Media is the world’s leading Managed Service provider to the media industry. Working with the best media brands in the world, we enrich and ensure media experiences.

Every day, people on all continents watch television programs prepared, managed and broadcast by Red Bee Media staff. Every year, the business delivers more than 2.7 million hours of programming in more than 60 languages for nearly 600 TV channels.

We’re looking to bring in skilled, collaborative developers to share knowledge and work with exciting new technologies to create innovative solutions to make media accessible to deaf and blind audiences, as well as understanding how these technologies can enhance the value and use of media more widely.

This role works as part of the Access Services department who provides over 230,000 hours of captioning each year – more than 100,000 hours of which is live. They also provide Audio Description and signing services, making the media and the world more... accessible for the deaf and hard of hearing and hard of sight.

What do we expect from you?

The role will require feature development from base requirements and user stories, coordination with test leads and product owners to validate progress, and deployment into test and production environments. Additionally, the role will require developing integration with related systems (e.g. client scheduling software, production software) and for ensuring the optimal configuration is achieved for use in production.

What we offer:
Permanent contract
Competitive Salary Package
Stable employment on the basis of an employment contract
You will benefit from a wide range of learning opportunities and knowledgeable colleagues
clearly defined career paths
Work-based on developing the latest solutions in the area of mobile technology
Work from home, flexible working hours, laptop and mobile phone.
Work-life balance

We welcome the opportunity to meet you!
